question: An Agentforce turned on Einstein Generative AI in Setup. Now, the Agentforce Specialist would like to create custom prompt templates in Prompt Builder. However, they cannot access Prompt Builder in the Setup menu. What is causing the problem?
options: The Prompt Template User permission set was not assigned correctly.
The Prompt Template Manager permission set was not assigned correctly.
The large language model (LLM) was not configured correctly in Data Cloud.
explanation: Para acceder y crear prompt templates personalizadas en Prompt Builder, el especialista de Agentforce debe tener asignado el conjunto de permisos Prompt Template Managers. Sin este permiso, no podrán acceder al Prompt Builder en el menú Configuración, aunque Einstein Generative AI esté habilitado. La opción B es correcta porque se requiere el conjunto de permisos del Prompt Template Managers para utilizar el Prompt Builder. La opción A (conjunto de permisos de usuario de prompt template) es incorrecta porque este permiso permite a los usuarios utilizar solicitudes, pero no crearlas ni administrarlas. La opción C (configuración LLM en Data Cloud) no está relacionada con la capacidad de acceder a Prompt Builder.

question: Universal Containers (UC) is implementing Einstein Generative AI to improve customer insights and interactions. UC needs audit and feedback data to be accessible for reporting purposes. What is a consideration for this requirement?
options: Storing this data requires Data Cloud to be provisioned.
Storing this data requires a custom object for data to be configured.
Storing this data requires Salesforce big objects.
explanation: Al implementar Einstein Generative AI para mejorar las interacciones y los conocimientos de los clientes, la nube de datos es una consideración clave para almacenar y gestionar datos de auditoría y retroalimentación a gran escala. Salesforce Data Cloud (anteriormente conocida como Customer 360 Audiences) está diseñada para manejar y unificar conjuntos de datos masivos de diversas fuentes, lo que la hace ideal para almacenar los datos necesarios para obtener información y generación de informes basados ​​en IA. Al aprovisionar Data Cloud, organizaciones como Universal Containers (UC) pueden obtener acceso en tiempo real a los datos de los clientes, convirtiéndolos en un repositorio central para informes unificados en varios sistemas. Los datos de auditoría y retroalimentación generados por Einstein Generative AI deben almacenarse en un entorno escalable y accesible, y Data Cloud proporciona esta capacidad, lo que garantiza que se pueda acceder fácilmente a los datos para generar informes, análisis y mejorar aún más el modelo. Los objetos personalizados o los Big Objects de Salesforce no están diseñados para la escala o el tipo específico de procesamiento de datos unificado en tiempo real requerido en dichas interacciones impulsadas por IA. Los Big Objects son más adecuados para archivar datos, mientras que Data Cloud garantiza capacidades de procesamiento, segmentación y análisis más sólidas.

question: Universal Containers is considering leveraging the Einstein Trust Layer in conjunction with Einstein Generative AI Audit Data. Which audit data is available using the Einstein Trust Layer?
options: Response accuracy and offensiveness score
Hallucination score and bias score
Masked data and toxicity score
explanation: Universal Containers está considerando el uso de Einstein Trust Layer junto con Einstein Generative AI Audit Data. Einstein Trust Layer proporciona una forma segura y compatible de utilizar la IA al ofrecer funciones como enmascaramiento de datos y evaluación de toxicidad. Los datos de auditoría disponibles a través de Einstein Trust Layer incluyen información sobre datos enmascarados (lo que garantiza que la información confidencial no quede expuesta) y la puntuación de toxicidad, que evalúa el contenido generado en busca de lenguaje inapropiado o dañino.

question: Universal Containers is evaluating Einstein Generative AI features to improve the productivity of the service center operation. Which features should the Agentforce Specialist recommend?
options: Service Replies and Case Summaries
Service Replies and Work Summaries
Reply Recommendations and Sales Summaries
explanation: Para mejorar la productividad del centro de servicio, el especialista de Agentforce debe recomendar las funciones Respuestas de servicio y Resúmenes de casos. Service Replies ayuda a los agentes generando automáticamente respuestas sugeridas a las consultas de los clientes, lo que reduce el tiempo de respuesta y mejora la eficiencia. Los resúmenes de casos brindan una descripción general rápida de los detalles del caso, lo que permite a los agentes ponerse al día más rápidamente sobre los problemas de los clientes. Los resúmenes de trabajo no son tan relevantes para las operaciones directas de servicio al cliente y los resúmenes de ventas se centran en los procesos de ventas, no en la productividad del centro de servicios. Para obtener más información, consulte la documentación de Einstein Service Cloud de Salesforce sobre el uso de IA generativa para ayudar a los equipos de servicio al cliente.

question: An Agentforce configured Data Masking within the Einstein Trust Layer. How should the Agentforce Specialist begin validating that the correct fields are being masked?
options: Use a Flow-based resource in Prompt Builder to debug the fields’ merge values using Flow Debugger.
Request the Einstein Generative AI Audit Data from the Security section of the Setup menu.
Enable the collection and storage of Einstein Generative AI Audit Data on the Einstein Feedback setup page.
explanation: Para comenzar a validar que se estén enmascarando los campos correctos en Einstein Trust Layer, el especialista de Agentforce debe solicitar los datos de auditoría de AI generativa de Einstein desde la sección Seguridad del menú Configuración de Salesforce. Estos datos de auditoría permiten al especialista de Agentforce ver cómo se procesan los datos, incluidos qué campos se están enmascarando, lo que brinda transparencia y validación de que la configuración funciona como se esperaba. La opción B es correcta porque permite la recuperación de datos de auditoría que pueden usarse para validar el enmascaramiento de datos. La opción A (depurador de flujo) y la opción C (comentarios de Einstein) no se relacionan con la validación del enmascaramiento de campos en el contexto de la capa de confianza de Einstein.

question: A customer wants to analyze complete agent interactions, from the initial user request through to the final resolution, to better understand agent behavior and response quality. Which Agentforce feature should an Agentforce Specialist recommend?
options: Agent Inspection
Agent Insights
Agent Optimization
explanation: Agentforce Optimization es la capa de análisis de observabilidad: agrupa sesiones similares, asigna quality scores a las respuestas, detecta patrones y gaps de configuración, y permite drill-down hasta el trace completo de una sesión (de la petición inicial a la resolución final). Es la herramienta indicada cuando el verbo es "analizar" comportamiento y calidad de respuestas. No confundir con Agentforce Session Tracing, que solo CAPTURA los datos crudos (razonamiento, prompts, gateway I/O, errores) que Optimization consume. "Agent Inspection" no es una feature oficial de observabilidad (distractor) y "Agent Insights" es un distractor del nombre real "Agentforce Analytics" (KPIs agregados, no análisis por interacción). Regla: capture/store/debug → Session Tracing; analyze/quality/patterns → Agent Optimization. Referencia: admin.salesforce.com "Gain Complete Visibility Into Your AI Agents With Agentforce Optimization".

question: Sunrays Limited (SL) is designing an agent to assist with order management and dealer support automation. The agent must verify a dealer's credentials before granting access to order details. The team has already: declared a variable is_verified to track verification status, and configured an action that verifies the dealer's credentials. They plan to restrict access to the order details subagent (formerly known as a topic) using a guard condition based on is_verified. What must the team do to ensure the order details subagent becomes available only after a dealer is successfully verified?
options: Add an available when: @variables.is_verified = true condition to the order details subagent.
Declare the is_verified variable as immutable so it cannot be modified during the session.
Update the is_verified variable to true after the verification action succeeds using @utils.setVariables.
explanation: Trampa clásica: la opción A solo repite el plan que el equipo YA tiene decidido (el guard condition "available when" ES el plan declarado en el enunciado). Lo que FALTA para que ese guard funcione es que la variable cambie de estado: si is_verified nunca se actualiza a true tras la verificación exitosa, la condición nunca se cumple y el subagente queda permanentemente inaccesible. En Agent Script, @utils.setVariables actualiza variables de forma determinista tras la acción de verificación. La opción B es directamente contraria: la variable DEBE ser mutable (false → true) para que el patrón funcione. Flujo: dealer → acción verificar → OK → setVariables is_verified=true → guard se abre → subagente order details disponible. Referencia: Agentforce Developer Guide, Agent Script — patrón Agent Router (verificación antes de enrutar a topics restringidos).

question: Sunrays Limited (SL) is configuring its Agentforce Testing Center to evaluate an agent handling customer complaints. The company wants to assess if the agent successfully demonstrates empathy and follows a proprietary "De-escalation Framework" before offering a resolution. Where should the Agentforce Specialist utilize a large language model (LLM)-as-judge to achieve an appropriate evaluation?
options: Adjust the fixed criteria of the standard Coherence quality evaluation to control the LLM-as-judge evaluation.
Enable the default Instruction Adherence evaluation which natively uses LLM-as judge.
Create a custom evaluation with a tailored prompt outlining the framework's criteria.
explanation: Un framework PROPIETARIO ("De-escalation Framework") no puede evaluarse con criterios estándar: requiere una custom evaluation en Testing Center, donde el Specialist escribe un prompt a medida que describe los criterios del framework (empatía, pasos de de-escalación antes de la resolución) y un LLM-as-judge puntúa las respuestas del agente contra esos criterios. La opción A es contradictoria: los criterios de la evaluación estándar de Coherence son fijos, no ajustables. La opción B (Instruction Adherence) evalúa si el agente sigue sus instrucciones en general, pero no valida los criterios específicos de un framework propietario de negocio. Regla: criterio estándar de calidad → evaluaciones incluidas (Coherence, Instruction Adherence); criterio propietario/de negocio → custom evaluation con prompt propio + LLM-as-judge.

question: An Agentforce Specialist is evaluating an agent conversation. What is the reason why intents and session metrics within Observability are important to consider?
options: To evaluate the agent's overall performance
To evaluate why the agent was unable to answer a user's question
To evaluate the deflection rate of the agent
explanation: La clave es que el enunciado nombra DOS elementos juntos: intents Y session metrics. La única opción que cubre ambos es la A (overall performance): los intents muestran qué piden los usuarios y qué tan bien lo maneja el agente (quality scores por intent), y las session metrics aportan resolución, escalación, duración y volumen — en conjunto, la evaluación integral del desempeño del agente. La B es tentadora pero solo mapea a los intents (unresolved interactions/knowledge gaps) e ignora las session metrics; además, diagnosticar POR QUÉ falló una respuesta concreta es tarea de Session Tracing, no de métricas. La C (deflection rate) es una sola session metric, demasiado específica. Regla de examen: si el enunciado nombra dos elementos, la respuesta correcta suele ser la opción que abarca ambos, no la más específica. [Nota de confianza: pregunta ambigua de dump, sin confirmación oficial; A verificada como correcta en otro simulador del usuario y por análisis — algunos dumps podrían marcar B.] Referencia: Salesforce Help "Learn About Agentforce Observability".

question: Sunrays Limited (SL) uses an agent to handle customer service inquiries. SL recently partnered with an external logistics provider that operates its own distinct, autonomous AI agent. When a customer requests a complex international shipping reroute, the SL agent needs to securely communicate, negotiate routing terms, and delegate the execution of the reroute directly to the logistics provider's AI agent. Which open standard multi-agent protocol is specifically designed to facilitate this autonomous task delegation and negotiation between independent AI agents?
options: Agent to Agent (A2A) Protocol
Model Context Protocol (MCP)
OpenAPI Specification (OAS)
explanation: Las señales clave del enunciado son "distinct, autonomous AI agent" externo + "negotiate" + "delegate execution": comunicación entre AGENTES independientes de distintos vendors → Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Protocol, el estándar abierto diseñado para descubrimiento, negociación y delegación de tareas entre agentes autónomos de forma segura e interoperable. MCP (opción B) conecta un agente con HERRAMIENTAS y modelos externos (tools, APIs, modelos predictivos), no con otro agente autónomo que negocia y ejecuta por su cuenta. OAS (opción C) es solo una especificación para describir contratos de APIs REST; no es un protocolo multi-agente. Regla: agente ↔ agente autónomo (delegar/negociar) → A2A; agente ↔ tools/modelos → MCP; describir una API → OAS. Relacionadas en esta base: #254 (cuándo usar A2A) y #274 (beneficio clave de A2A).

question: Sunrays Limited (SL) has been building an agent using Canvas. It has created an "Issue Refund" action. Business rules dictate that refunds can only be issued if the customer's Account_Tier is "Platinum". Currently, the agent relies on its system instructions to check the tier, but it occasionally hallucinates authorization and attempts to call the refund action for Standard customers, resulting in backend errors. How should the Agentforce Specialist use filters to deterministically ensure the agent cannot process the "Issue Refund" action unless the customer meets the criteria?
options: Configure an Action Condition filter so the "Issue Refund" action is only available when the Account_Tier variable equals "Platinum".
Strengthen the system instructions with absolute keywords like "NEVER issue refunds unless the tier is Platinum".
Create a validation rule on the backend object to reject refund records created for non-Platinum accounts.
explanation: Las instrucciones dependen del LLM (probabilísticas: por eso "alucina autorización"). El único mecanismo determinista en Canvas/Agentforce Builder es un filtro condicional sobre la acción (Action Condition filter) con la variable de contexto Account_Tier = "Platinum": la acción ni siquiera se le ofrece al LLM si no se cumple. La validación backend (C) evita el daño pero no impide el intento ni el error. Gemela conceptual: #126 (AccountStatus = Active). Regla: instrucciones = guía; filtros + variables = garantía. [Reportada examen 2026 — pools jun-jul 2026; patrón confirmado en doc oficial de filtros: help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=ai.agent_asset_filters.htm]

question: Ursa Major Solar is building its first agent with Agent Script in Agentforce Builder. A developer declares a variable in the variables block as "discount_count: mutable number" but the script fails to compile. What is the cause of the error?
options: Mutable variables must declare a default value, for example: discount_count: mutable number = 0.
The number type is not supported for variables; the developer must use string instead.
Variables can only be declared inside a subagent block, not at the top level.
explanation: En Agent Script toda variable mutable DEBE declarar un valor por defecto; sin él, el script no compila. "number" sí es un tipo válido (string, number, boolean, object, date, id, list[tipo]) y las variables se declaran precisamente en el bloque variables de nivel superior. [Generada v3 — fuente: developer.salesforce.com/docs/ai/agentforce/guide/ascript-ref-variables.html]

question: Cloud Kicks wrote the following declaration in Agent Script: "is_vip: mutable boolean = false". The compiler rejects the line. Which change fixes the error?
options: Wrap the value in quotes: "false".
Capitalize the boolean: is_vip: mutable boolean = False.
Change the type keyword from boolean to bool.
explanation: Los booleanos en Agent Script siguen el estilo Python y van capitalizados: True / False. Escribir false o true en minúscula es un error de sintaxis; el tipo sí se llama boolean. [Generada v3 — fuente: developer.salesforce.com/docs/ai/agentforce/guide/ascript-ref-expressions.html]

question: Northern Trail Outfitters needs three-tier routing in its agent: Gold customers to concierge, Silver to standard support, and everyone else to self-service. A developer writes "if / else if / else" in the deterministic instructions and gets a syntax error. What should the developer do?
options: Nest a second if/else inside the else block, because Agent Script supports if and else but does NOT support else if.
Replace else if with the elif keyword.
Use a switch statement, which is the supported multi-branch construct.
explanation: La documentación oficial lo dice textualmente: "Agent Script admite la lógica if y else, pero no admite else if" (tampoco elif ni switch). Para más de dos ramas se anidan bloques si dentro del else. [Generada v3 — fuente: desarrollador.salesforce.com/docs/ai/agentforce/guide/ascript-ref-instructions.html]

question: Sunrays Limited wants its agent to compute an order total with 19% tax directly in Agent Script deterministic logic: total = @variables.subtotal * 1.19. The expression fails. What should the Agentforce Specialist recommend?
options: Delegate the calculation to a Flow or Apex action, because Agent Script arithmetic only supports + and - (no *, / or %).
Add parentheses around the multiplication so the parser accepts it.
Use the built-in @utils.calculate utility for arithmetic operations.
explanation: Agent Script solo soporta suma y resta; multiplicación, división y módulo no existen en el lenguaje, y @utils.calculate no es una utilidad real (las únicas son transition to, escalate, setVariables y end_session). Cálculos complejos → Flow/Apex action. [Generada v3 — fuente: developer.salesforce.com/docs/ai/agentforce/guide/ascript-ref-operators.html]

question: Coral Cloud Resorts wants the "checkout" tool of its booking agent to be offered to the LLM only when the shopping cart has items. Which syntax is valid in reasoning.actions?
options: available if @variables.cart_has_items == True
available when @variables.cart_has_items == True
require @variables.cart_has_items == True
explanation: El guard condition de herramientas en reasoning.actions se escribe exactamente "available when" seguido de una expresión condicional válida. "available if" y "require" no existen en el lenguaje. Si la condición no se cumple, la herramienta ni siquiera se le ofrece al LLM (gate determinista). [Generada v3 — fuente: developer.salesforce.com/docs/ai/agentforce/guide/ascript-ref-tools.html]

question: Universal Containers requires that when its payment subagent finishes, the conversation ALWAYS moves to the survey subagent — without leaving the decision to the LLM. How should this be implemented in Agent Script?
options: In the after_reasoning block, write: transition to @subagent.survey (without the @utils. prefix).
In reasoning.actions, add: go_survey: @utils.transition to @subagent.survey.
Write: set @utils.transition = @subagent.survey at the end of the instructions.
explanation: Regla estrella de sintaxis: en bloques de directivas deterministas (instructions:-> o after_reasoning) la transición se escribe "transition to @subagent.X" a secas y se ejecuta SIEMPRE; en reasoning.actions se usa "@utils.transition to" pero ahí es el LLM quien decide si invocarla — no garantiza el "always". La opción C no es sintaxis válida. [Generada v3 — fuente: developer.salesforce.com/docs/ai/agentforce/guide/ascript-patterns-transitions.html]

question: Sunrays Limited runs the action get_order and needs to store the returned status in a variable for later guard conditions. Which Agent Script construct is correct?
options: run @actions.get_order ... set @variables.order_status = @outputs.status
run @actions.get_order ... @utils.setVariables with order_status extracted from the response
run @actions.get_order ... set @variables.order_status = @inputs.status
explanation: Los outputs de una acción se capturan con set usando @outputs (nunca @inputs). @utils.setVariables sirve para que el LLM extraiga valores DE LA CONVERSACIÓN (ej. el nombre que dijo el cliente), no para capturar salidas de acciones. [Generada v3 — fuente: developer.salesforce.com/docs/ai/agentforce/guide/ascript-ref-actions.html]

question: A developer at Cloud Kicks writes the line "Apologize for the delay." directly inside a deterministic instructions:-> block and the script fails to parse. Why?
options: Natural-language prompt text inside logic blocks must be prefixed with the pipe character: | Apologize for the delay.
Apologies require the @utils.say utility.
Free text must be wrapped in double quotes inside logic blocks.
explanation: En Agent Script conviven dos sintaxis: -> introduce lógica determinista y | introduce texto en lenguaje natural para el LLM; ambas pueden mezclarse línea a línea, pero el texto de prompt SIEMPRE lleva |. @utils.say no existe. [Generada v3 — fuente: developer.salesforce.com/docs/ai/agentforce/guide/ascript-lang.html]

question: Universal Containers declares "session_id: linked string = 'TBD'" with a source mapping and gets a compile error. What is wrong?
options: Linked variables get their value exclusively from their source and cannot declare a default value.
Linked variables must also include the mutable keyword.
String defaults require double quotes instead of single quotes.
explanation: Las variables linked se alimentan de su source (ej. @session.sessionID), NO admiten default, no pueden ser object ni list, y el agente no puede escribirlas (son de solo lectura). Combinar linked con mutable o con default es inválido. [Generada v3 — fuente: developer.salesforce.com/docs/ai/agentforce/guide/ascript-ref-variables.html]

question: A Sunrays Limited developer wants the LLM to fill a customer's name from the conversation and declares: "customer_name: mutable string = ...". The compiler rejects it. What is the correct use of the "..." token?
options: "..." is only valid as an action input value (with name=...) to tell the LLM to slot-fill it from the conversation; it can't be a variable default.
"..." is valid but only for number variables.
"..." must be wrapped in {! } template braces to work as a default.
explanation: El token "..." significa "el LLM rellena este valor desde la conversación" (slot-filling) y solo aplica a inputs de acciones con with. Como default de variable es un error típico de examen. [Generada v3 — fuente: developer.salesforce.com/docs/ai/agentforce/guide/ascript-ref-actions.html]

question: A new teammate at Coral Cloud Resorts defines "subagent order management:" in Agent Script and the parser fails. Which naming rule was violated?
options: Names can't contain spaces; they must start with a letter and use only alphanumerics and underscores (e.g., order_management).
Subagent names must be wrapped in double quotes when they contain spaces.
Subagent names must use CamelCase by convention, so OrderManagement is required.
explanation: Reglas de nombres: empiezan con letra (no underscore), solo alfanuméricos y _, sin espacios, sin __ consecutivos, no terminan en _, máximo 80 caracteres; "escalate" es palabra reservada. snake_case es la convención recomendada, no CamelCase obligatorio. [Generada v3 — fuente: developer.salesforce.com/docs/ai/agentforce/guide/ascript-lang.html]

question: Coral Cloud Resorts' booking subagent needs to consult the weather subagent mid-conversation and then CONTINUE with the booking flow. Which Agent Script pattern supports this?
options: Reference @subagent.weather as a tool in reasoning.actions — delegation returns control to the caller when it finishes.
Use @utils.transition to @subagent.weather, which automatically returns after the weather answer.
Duplicate the weather actions inside the booking subagent, because subagents can't communicate.
explanation: Las transiciones (@utils.transition to / transition to) son UNIDIRECCIONALES: descartan el contexto y no regresan. Para consultar y volver se usa la delegación: referenciar el otro subagent como herramienta, que sí retorna al llamador. [Generada v3 — fuente: developer.salesforce.com/docs/ai/agentforce/guide/ascript-patterns-transitions.html]

question: Sunrays Limited has a compliance rule: the log_consent action must ALWAYS run before process_payment. Today both live in reasoning.actions and the LLM occasionally skips the consent step. What should the Agentforce Specialist implement?
options: Move the sequence to deterministic instructions: run @actions.log_consent followed by run @actions.process_payment, guaranteeing order on every conversation.
Strengthen the topic instructions with "ALWAYS log consent first" in capital letters.
Keep both in reasoning.actions but rewrite their descriptions to hint the order.
explanation: run en bloques deterministas ejecuta las acciones como código, en el orden escrito, sin depender del razonamiento del LLM. Instrucciones y descripciones son probabilísticas — exactamente el fallo que reporta el escenario. [Reportada examen 2026 (pools jun-jul) — patrón confirmado en developer.salesforce.com/docs/ai/agentforce/guide/ascript-ref-instructions.html]

question: A Universal Containers developer creates a new Agent Script with config, variables, start_agent and one subagent, but it fails validation with missing-block errors. What is missing?
options: The system block with messages.welcome and messages.error, which are mandatory.
A topics block declaring at least one topic.
An @utils.init call to bootstrap the agent.
explanation: Bloques requeridos: config (developer_name), system con messages.welcome y messages.error obligatorios, start_agent y al menos un subagent. NO existe un bloque "topics" (son subagents) ni @utils.init. [Generada v3 — fuente: developer.salesforce.com/docs/ai/agentforce/guide/ascript-blocks.html]

question: A developer migrating from the legacy builder mindset writes "@topics.returns" in Agent Script to reference the returns flow and gets an unknown-reference error. What is the correct reference?
options: @subagent.returns — valid references are @variables, @actions, @subagent (singular), @outputs and @utils.
@subagents.returns, using the plural form.
topics.returns, without the @ prefix.
explanation: @topics no existe en el lenguaje (el concepto se llama subagent desde abril 2026) y la referencia va en singular: @subagent.x. Dentro de texto de prompt, las referencias se interpolan con {!@variables.x}. [Generada v3 — fuente: developer.salesforce.com/docs/ai/agentforce/guide/ascript-lang.html]

question: Golden Bank must guarantee that its KYC verification steps run in an exact, auditable order for regulators, while the rest of the customer conversation stays natural and flexible. Which Agentforce capability best meets both needs in a single agent?
options: Hybrid reasoning with Agent Script: deterministic instructions (->) executed like code for the KYC sequence, plus natural-language prompt instructions (|) interpreted by the LLM for the conversation.
Fine-tune the underlying LLM on the bank's compliance manuals.
Build two separate agents: one deterministic and one conversational.
explanation: Eso ES hybrid reasoning: combinar en el mismo agente lógica determinista (se ejecuta sin LLM, orden garantizado) e instrucciones interpretadas por el LLM. No requiere fine-tuning ni duplicar agentes. [Generada v3 — fuente: developer.salesforce.com/blogs/2025/10/introducing-hybrid-reasoning-with-agent-script]

question: An architect at Sunrays Limited asks how Agent Script actually executes at runtime before approving its use. What should the Agentforce Specialist answer?
options: Agent Script is compiled into an Agent Graph that the Atlas Reasoning Engine consumes — it is not interpreted line by line at runtime nor read as a prompt.
The script is transpiled to Apex classes deployed to the org.
The LLM receives the whole script as part of its system prompt and follows it.
explanation: Agent Script es un DSL declarativo compilado: genera un Agent Graph que configura al Atlas Reasoning Engine (ese es el mecanismo del hybrid reasoning). No se convierte en Apex ni se inyecta como prompt. [Generada v3 — fuente: developer.salesforce.com/blogs/2025/10/introducing-hybrid-reasoning-with-agent-script]

question: An airline is designing its refund agent: refund thresholds and eligibility sequence must never vary, but apology wording should adapt to each customer's situation. How should logic be distributed in Agent Script?
options: Thresholds and sequence in deterministic logic lines (->); tone and wording in prompt lines (|) for the LLM.
Everything in deterministic logic (->) to maximize control.
Everything in prompt lines (|) so the LLM handles both.
explanation: Criterio de diseño del hybrid reasoning: lo que no puede variar (reglas de negocio, secuencias, umbrales) va en lógica determinista; lo que debe adaptarse (tono, empatía, redacción) va en instrucciones de prompt. Todo -> pierde flexibilidad conversacional; todo | pierde garantías. [Generada v3 — fuente: architect.salesforce.com/docs/architect/fundamentals/guide/hybrid-reasoning-agentforce-builder-agent-script]

question: Universal Containers has admins who prefer clicks and developers who prefer code working on the same agent. Which Agentforce Builder capability supports both profiles without duplicating work?
options: Agentforce Builder offers three synchronized views of the same agent: document view, low-code canvas view, and script view (Agent Script).
Install both the legacy Agent Builder for admins and a separate IDE product for developers.
Only the script view allows editing; the other views are read-only previews.
explanation: El nuevo Agentforce Builder (GA Spring '26, dentro de Agentforce Studio) expone el MISMO agente en 3 vistas sincronizadas — documento, canvas y script — de modo que admins y devs editan la que prefieran. [Generada v3 — fuente: salesforce.com/news/press-releases/2025/10/13/agentic-enterprise-announcement/]

question: An admin at Cloud Kicks returns from a 6-month leave and finds "subagents" everywhere the org used to say "topics". She asks what she must migrate before the next release. What should the Agentforce Specialist answer?
options: Nothing — topics were renamed to subagents in April 2026 with no functional change; existing configuration keeps working.
Subagents are a new feature replacing topics; all topics must be rebuilt as subagents manually.
The rename only applies to the legacy builder; the new builder still uses topics.
explanation: Renombre puro (abril 2026): mismo comportamiento, cero migración. Trampa clásica de renombres — igual que Data Cloud → Data 360. En Agent Script la keyword es subagent/start_agent. [Generada v3 — fuente: developer.salesforce.com/workshops/agentforce-new-workshop/builder/2-extend-agents-with-topics-and-actions]

question: Sunrays Limited's CFO reads that "Data Cloud is now Data 360" and worries about license renegotiation and re-implementing data streams. What should the Agentforce Specialist clarify?
options: It is only a rebrand (October 2025): product, licenses, integrations and data model remain unchanged — no migration needed.
Data 360 is a different product that coexists with Data Cloud, so both licenses are required.
Data streams must be recreated under the Data 360 schema before Spring '26.
explanation: Data 360 es el sexto nombre del mismo producto (Customer 360 Audiences → CDP → Genie → Data Cloud → Data 360). Nada cambia técnica ni contractualmente; es la capa de datos/contexto del paraguas Agentforce 360, donde además se almacena el STDM. [Generada v3 — fuente: salesforceben.com/salesforce-data-cloud-renamed-to-data-360-as-part-of-agentforce-360/]

question: A newly hired Agentforce Specialist at Universal Containers asks which tools make up Agentforce Studio so she can plan the team's build-test-monitor lifecycle. What is the correct composition?
options: Agentforce Builder + Testing Center + Observability.
Prompt Builder + Model Builder + Flow Builder.
Legacy Agent Builder + Data Cloud + Trust Layer.
explanation: Agentforce Studio (oct-nov 2025) agrupa el ciclo de vida completo del agente: construir (Agentforce Builder), probar (Testing Center) y monitorear (Observability: Analytics + Optimization + Health Monitoring). [Generada v3 — fuente: salesforce.com/news/stories/agentforce-studio-observability-tools-announcement/]

question: Sunrays Limited's CTO asks what Salesforce means by the "agentic enterprise" stack announced at Dreamforce '25, to align the company's roadmap. Which four ingredients compose Agentforce 360?
options: Agentforce 360 Platform + Data 360 + Customer 360 Apps + Slack.
Sales Cloud + Service Cloud + Marketing Cloud + Tableau.
Atlas Reasoning Engine + Einstein Trust Layer + Prompt Builder + MuleSoft.
explanation: Los 4 ingredientes oficiales del "agentic enterprise": la plataforma Agentforce 360, Data 360 (datos/contexto), las Customer 360 Apps (rebautizadas: Agentforce Sales, Agentforce Service...) y Slack como interfaz conversacional. [Generada v3 — fuente: salesforce.com/news/press-releases/2025/10/13/agentic-enterprise-announcement/]

question: Universal Containers' COO wants weekly trends of agent KPIs — usage, engagement, ineffective topics and actions — to steer the roadmap. Which Agentforce Observability pillar provides this?
options: Agent Analytics: aggregated performance dashboards and KPI trends.
Agent Health Monitoring: near-real-time alerts on errors and latency.
Agent Optimization: per-session traces and clustering.
explanation: Los 3 pilares de Observability se distinguen por la pregunta que responden: Analytics = "¿cómo va el agente en agregado?" (KPIs, tendencias); Optimization = "¿por qué falló esta interacción?" (trazas, clustering, quality scores); Health Monitoring = "¿está sano AHORA?" (alertas casi en tiempo real). Aquí piden tendencias agregadas → Analytics. [Generada v3 — fuente: salesforce.com/news/stories/agentforce-studio-observability-tools-announcement/]

question: Sunrays Limited's platform team needs near-real-time alerts when the production agent shows critical errors, latency spikes, or a sudden surge of escalations. Which capability should the Agentforce Specialist enable?
options: Agent Health Monitoring (GA Spring '26), the Observability pillar for uptime and reliability alerts.
Agent Analytics, reviewing the KPI dashboard each morning.
Digital Wallet, which alerts on abnormal consumption.
explanation: Agent Health Monitoring es el pilar de fiabilidad: alertas casi en tiempo real de errores críticos, picos de latencia y escalaciones. Analytics es agregado/retrospectivo y Digital Wallet mide consumo de créditos, no salud operativa. [Generada v3 — fuente: salesforce.com/news/stories/agentforce-studio-observability-tools-announcement/]

question: An external audit asks Universal Containers WHERE the detailed traces of its agents live — user inputs, agent responses, reasoning steps, LLM calls and guardrail checks — and in what form. What should the Agentforce Specialist answer?
options: In the Session Tracing Data Model (STDM), stored as data model objects (DMOs) in Data 360.
In the platform Event Log Files, downloadable via the Event Monitoring API.
In the Einstein Trust Layer audit trail, retained outside the org.
explanation: El STDM registra inputs del usuario, respuestas, pasos de razonamiento, llamadas al LLM y checks de guardrails, y se almacena como DMOs en Data 360 (por eso Observability puede consultarlo y hacer clustering). No son Event Log Files ni el audit trail del Trust Layer (ese cubre prompts/masking). [Generada v3 — fuente: help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=ai.generative_ai_session_trace_data_model.htm]

question: Coral Cloud Resorts' CX lead wants to group similar production sessions into clusters, spot friction points, and see quality scores per intent to prioritize fixes. Which Observability pillar does she need?
options: Agent Optimization.
Agent Analytics.
Agentforce Testing Center.
explanation: Agent Optimization es el pilar de análisis profundo: clustering de sesiones similares, moments por intent, quality scores (LLM-as-judge) y drill-down hasta la traza. Analytics da KPIs agregados y Testing Center opera PRE-despliegue, no sobre sesiones de producción. [Generada v3 — fuente: admin.salesforce.com/blog/2025/gain-complete-visibility-into-your-ai-agents-with-agentforce-optimization]

question: A service manager at Sunrays Limited asks for the agent's escalation rate to humans, average session duration, and the topics with the worst resolution rates. Which solution provides these metrics?
options: Agentforce Observability: Agent Analytics dashboards built on the Session Tracing Data Model.
The Einstein Trust Layer Audit Trail filtered by session.
The Salesforce Optimizer report for agents.
explanation: KPIs de conversación (escalation rate, duración media, resolución por topic) = Agent Analytics sobre el STDM. El Audit Trail del Trust Layer audita prompts/masking y Salesforce Optimizer es una herramienta de higiene de la org, no de agentes. [Reportada examen 2026 (pools jun-jul 2026)]

question: Universal Containers' QA team finds that agent failures only appear at turn 3 or 4 of long conversations — single-utterance test cases never catch them. Which Testing Center capability should they adopt?
options: Multi-turn testing: import full conversations from Agentforce Builder and replay them turn by turn, using the accumulated history as context.
Repeat the same utterance four times in a single test case.
These failures can only be reproduced manually in production.
explanation: El multi-turn testing (nov 2025) reproduce conversaciones completas con el historial acumulado como contexto, capturando fallos que solo emergen con estado conversacional. Repetir una utterance no reproduce el contexto de turnos previos. [Generada v3 — fuente: developer.salesforce.com/blogs/2025/11/automate-multi-turn-agent-testing-with-conversation-history-in-agentforce]

question: Sunrays Limited's web agent (Messaging for In-App and Web) relies on context variables from the MessagingSession. Testers complain these variables can't be exercised in Agentforce Builder's preview. How can they be tested before deployment?
options: Use Testing Center's support for simulating context variables with real MessagingSession values inside test cases (Summer '25).
Activate the agent in production and test with a real portal user.
Convert all context variables to custom variables so the Builder preview can set them.
explanation: Las context variables no se pueden probar en el preview del Builder porque requieren una sesión de messaging real; Testing Center (release 256 / Summer '25) permite simularlas con valores reales de MessagingSession en los tests. Convertirlas a custom variables cambia la semántica (dejan de venir del canal). [Generada v3 — fuente: help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=release-notes.rn_einstein_context_variables.htm]

question: Sunrays Limited wants its service agent to use tools from Stripe (payments) and Box (documents) without writing custom code for each API. What is the recommended 2026 approach?
options: Use Agentforce's native MCP client: discover the partners' MCP servers on AgentExchange, connect them from the Builder without code, and govern them via MuleSoft's AI Agent Gateway.
Build one custom Apex action per Stripe and Box endpoint.
Use the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol to delegate payment tasks to Stripe.
explanation: Agentforce actúa como cliente MCP nativo (Agentforce 3, jun 2025; GA ampliada 2026): los MCP servers de 30+ partners se descubren en AgentExchange y se gobiernan con el AI Agent Gateway de MuleSoft. A2A es para hablar con OTROS AGENTES, no con herramientas/APIs. [Generada v3 — fuente: salesforce.com/news/press-releases/2025/06/23/agentforce-3-announcement/]

question: Universal Containers has two needs: (1) its agent must call an external document-classification service as a tool, and (2) it must delegate research tasks to a partner company's autonomous agent. Which protocol fits each need?
options: MCP for (1) — vertical access to tools and data; A2A for (2) — lateral agent-to-agent communication and delegation.
A2A for both, since both involve external systems.
MCP for both, since both involve integrations.
explanation: Distinción conceptual clave del examen: MCP conecta agentes con HERRAMIENTAS/datos/sistemas (vertical); A2A conecta agentes con OTROS AGENTES autónomos, incluso de otros vendors (lateral). A2A + Multi-Agent Orchestration alcanzaron GA el 15-jun-2026 con Atlas 3.0. [Generada v3 — fuente: salesforce.com/agentforce/ai-agents/agent2agent-protocol/]

question: Coral Cloud Resorts deployed an orchestrator agent that routes work to three specialist agents, but requests frequently land on the wrong specialist. According to how orchestration works (GA June 2026), what is the FIRST thing to fix?
options: Improve each specialist agent's/subagent's DESCRIPTION — the orchestrator routes by reading the registered agents' descriptions and actions.
Raise the orchestrator's temperature so it explores more routing options.
Rename the specialist agents with numeric prefixes to force priority order.
explanation: En Multi-Agent Orchestration el criterio principal de enrutamiento son las descripciones de los agentes/subagents registrados (y sus acciones); descripciones vagas = enrutamiento errático. No existen prioridades por nombre y la temperatura no gobierna el routing. [Generada v3 — fuente: techtimes.com/articles/318456/20260616/salesforce-agentforce-multi-agent-orchestration-hits-ga-agent-descriptions-now-drive-reliability.htm]

question: Sunrays Limited enabled Credential-Based User Verification for its Experience Cloud portal agent. Support notices that records created by the agent show the authenticated portal user in Last Modified By, and asks if something is broken. What should the Agentforce Specialist answer?
options: It is expected behavior: with credential-based verification the agent performs DML in the authenticated user's context, respecting sharing and field-level security.
It is a bug: the agent should always run as the Agent User in system mode.
The Agent User is missing the Run Flows permission, which forces user context.
explanation: Con verificación de usuario credential-based, las operaciones corren en el contexto del usuario verificado (auditoría refleja al usuario real, sharing y FLS aplican). No es un bug ni un tema de Run Flows. [Reportada examen 2026 (pools jun-jul 2026)]

question: A Cloud Kicks developer writes: available when @variables.is_member && @variables.has_points — and the Agent Script compiler rejects the expression. What is the correct form?
options: available when @variables.is_member and @variables.has_points — logical operators are Python-style: and, or, not.
available when @variables.is_member & @variables.has_points — single ampersand.
Guard conditions do not accept compound expressions; split into two tools.
explanation: Los operadores lógicos de Agent Script son and / or / not (estilo Python); && y || no existen. Los guards sí aceptan expresiones compuestas, incluso con paréntesis: (a or b) and c. [Generada v3 — fuente: developer.salesforce.com/docs/ai/agentforce/guide/ascript-ref-operators.html]

question: A Universal Containers developer writes an Agent Script guard condition as "available when @variables.IsActive = True" and the compiler rejects it. A teammate suggests it is a comparison problem. What is the correct rule?
options: Use == for comparison in conditions; a single = is only used for assignment (after set) and is invalid inside available when.
Use the keyword equals, because symbols are not allowed in guard conditions.
Both = and == are interchangeable in Agent Script conditions.
explanation: En Agent Script la comparación es estricta con == (también !=, <, <=, >, >=, is / is not); el = simple es solo asignación tras set. Confundirlos es de los errores de sintaxis más preguntados. [Reportada examen 2026 (pools Spring '26) — regla confirmada en developer.salesforce.com/docs/ai/agentforce/guide/ascript-ref-operators.html]

question: Sunrays Limited's QA team is sizing its regression suite for the Agentforce Testing Center and asks about the practical limits and the format of expected results. What should the Agentforce Specialist tell them?
options: Each test supports up to 1,000 test cases (CSV), and expected values must use the API names of the expected topic and actions; run the suite in a sandbox.
Test cases are unlimited, and expected values are written in natural language for the LLM-as-judge to interpret.
Each test supports a maximum of 50 cases, and results must be validated manually one by one.
explanation: Límites operativos del Testing Center: hasta 1,000 test cases por test vía plantilla CSV, y los valores esperados se expresan con API names (Expected Topic API Name / acciones), lo que da lógica pass/fail consistente; mejores prácticas: ejecutarlo en sandbox. (Dato adicional reportado: ~10 test jobs por ventana de 10 horas — confianza media.) [Reportada examen 2026 — límites confirmados en help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=ai.agent_testing_center.htm]

question: Coral Cloud Resorts updates its policy documents monthly. The team wants the agent to ALWAYS answer from the current published version without re-uploading files or rebuilding anything manually. Which Data Library source should they choose?
options: A Knowledge-based Data Library: Knowledge articles have native versioning, so the library always serves the currently published version.
A file upload-based Data Library, re-uploading the PDFs after each monthly update.
Either source behaves the same; versioning is handled by the retriever.
explanation: Diferencia clave entre fuentes de Data Library: Knowledge aporta versionado nativo (publicar una nueva versión actualiza lo que el agente recupera); la fuente de archivos no versiona — exige re-subir y reindexar. El retriever no gestiona versiones. [Reportada examen 2026 (pools jun-jul) — help.salesforce.com: Agentforce Data Library sources]

question: Universal Containers grounds its agent with three search indexes (manuals, policies, past cases) and the prompt template is becoming hard to maintain with three separate retrievers. Results also need a single relevance ranking. What should the Agentforce Specialist configure in Einstein Studio?
options: An Ensemble Retriever, which ranks the combined results of multiple retrievers and lets the prompt template reference fewer individual retrievers.
Three additional individual retrievers with stricter filters on each index.
A single search index merging the three data sources into one DMO.
explanation: Einstein Studio ofrece dos tipos: Individual Retriever (un índice, con filtros propios) y Ensemble Retriever (combina y re-rankea resultados de múltiples retrievers, simplificando el prompt template). Fusionar índices heterogéneos en un DMO no es la práctica recomendada. [Reportada examen 2026 — verificado en Einstein Studio > Retrievers > New Retriever (help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=data.c360_a_ai_retriever_create.htm)]

question: Sunrays Limited configures a Knowledge-based Data Library. Its Knowledge articles are very long, and the team must choose which field to use as the Identifying Field for the search index. Which choice follows best practice?
options: A text field containing a concise summary of the article, so retrieval can locate the right article efficiently.
The full article body field, to give the index maximum information.
A formula field concatenating title, body and categories.
explanation: Los Identifying Fields sirven para LOCALIZAR el artículo correcto (los Content Fields aportan el contenido detallado a la respuesta). Para artículos largos, la práctica es usar un campo de resumen conciso como identificador; el body completo va como content field, y las fórmulas concatenadas no son adecuadas. Complementa a #157 (identifying vs content). [Reportada examen 2026 (pools jun-jul 2026)]

question: Universal Containers' development team hears two new Salesforce product names and asks the Agentforce Specialist to clarify: What are Agentforce Vibes and Intelligent Context, respectively?
options: Vibes: an enterprise AI "vibe coding" assistant that generates code (e.g., Apex/LWC) grounded in the org's metadata and governance; Intelligent Context: a managed pipeline that parses, chunks and enriches unstructured content to ground agents.
Two names for the same feature: the conversational view of Agentforce Builder.
Vibes: a sentiment-analysis dashboard; Intelligent Context: the LLM's conversation memory.
explanation: Anunciados con Agentforce 360 (Dreamforce '25): Agentforce Vibes = desarrollo asistido "vibe coding" consciente de los metadatos y la gobernanza de la org (Vibes IDE + Agentforce DX MCP Server); Intelligent Context = preparación gestionada de contenido no estructurado (parsing/chunking/enriquecimiento, conectando datos CRM con PDFs, emails, transcripciones) para grounding. [Generada v3 — fuente: salesforce.com/news/press-releases/2025/10/13/agentic-enterprise-announcement/]

question: Sunrays Limited (SL) has built a custom retriever grounding AI responses with technical documentation. SL now requires that a summary field from the search index be included in the output to provide a brief overview of each retrieved document. What is the recommended course of action for SL?
options: Create a completely new custom retriever with an entirely revised configuration that incorporates the summary field, and delete the current retriever. Editing the existing retriever is not possible.

Edit the existing retriever version to add the summary field to the list of fields returned by the retriever, save the changes, and activate the new version so that prompt templates use the updated configuration.
Use only the default retriever, which will automatically include all available fields from the search index, including the summary field, without any need to create or manage custom retrievers.
explanation: Los recuperadores personalizados en Einstein Studio/Data Cloud son editables: un administrador puede abrir el recuperador existente, agregar o eliminar campos de la lista de campos devueltos (incluido un campo de resumen), guardar el cambio como una nueva versión y activar esa versión para que las prompt templates fundamentados recojan la actualización. No es necesario eliminar ni volver a crear el recuperador, y el recuperador predeterminado no expone selectivamente un campo de resumen seleccionado como lo hace un recuperador personalizado configurado. [Reportada examen 2026 (banco julio 2026)]

question: Sunrays Limited (SL) has long, complex legal agreements. An Agentforce agent must be able to retrieve specific clauses that are often nested within larger sections. The standard chunking method is failing to capture the full context of these clauses. Which chunking strategy should an administrator use to preserve the structure of the documents?
options: Implement a smaller chunk size.
Implement a larger chunk size.
Implement a keyword-based chunking strategy.
explanation: Cuando las cláusulas están anidadas dentro de secciones más grandes, un tamaño de fragmento más pequeño empeora el problema al cortar una cláusula de la sección circundante que le da significado. Aumentar el tamaño del fragmento mantiene las cláusulas anidadas junto con su sección/contexto principal, preservando la estructura del documento y mejorando la precisión de la recuperación de textos legales largos y complejos. Una estrategia basada en palabras clave ignora por completo la estructura del documento y no es un enfoque de fragmentación compatible para este caso de uso. [Reportada examen 2026 (banco julio 2026)]

question: An Agentforce Specialist is working declaratively on version 4 of a prompt template which is significantly different from the previous version 3. A bug is then identified in version 3 and requires a hotfix to be deployed to production immediately by another team. The team will deploy this change as a new version. What should the specialist do to ensure that their work on the latest version is not lost and does not conflict with the new version?
options: Create a new prompt template with the bug fix, update all references to the new version, and delete the old prompt template.
Save their work in version 4, and allow the template to be deployed with a new version 5 containing the fix.
Copy and paste version 4 into a backup file or version-control alternative, and allow the other team to overwrite the contents of version 4 with the bug-fixed version.
explanation: Prompt Builder mantiene intactas todas las versiones guardadas de una plantilla y las versiones son aditivas: guardar la versión 4 no impide que otro equipo implemente su revisión como una nueva versión 5 separada construida a partir de la versión 3. Esto preserva el trabajo en progreso del especialista en la versión 4 y permite que la revisión se envíe de inmediato, sin necesidad de sobrescribir ni realizar copias de seguridad manuales. Eliminar la plantilla (A) destruye el historial de versiones y dejar que se sobrescriba la versión 4 (C) hace perder el trabajo del especialista. [Reportada examen 2026 (banco julio 2026)]

question: Sunrays Limited (SL) has built a Service Agent for its hospitality brand grounded on a knowledge data library containing 200 FAQ articles covering reservations, amenities, and cancellation policies. The project team estimates that manually authoring test cases to achieve adequate knowledge coverage would take 3 weeks. A junior administrator proposes that Testing Center can significantly accelerate this process. Which step should an Agentforce Specialist take to generate a comprehensive initial test suite without manual authoring of individual test cases?
options: Upload test cases.
Generate test cases based on the knowledge available to the agent.
Generate test cases based on subagent (formerly known as a topic) and actions.
explanation: Testing Center puede generar automáticamente un conjunto de pruebas inicial directamente a partir del contenido que conecta al agente. Cuando el objetivo es validar la cobertura del conocimiento (por ejemplo, artículos de preguntas frecuentes en una biblioteca de datos), generar casos de prueba a partir del conocimiento disponible para el agente produce preguntas de prueba representativas de todo el contenido fundamentado sin que nadie escriba a mano cada caso de prueba, lo que reduce semanas de creación manual. Cargar casos de prueba (A) todavía requiere que alguien los cree primero, y generarlos a partir de subagentes/acciones (C) valida el enrutamiento de temas/acciones en lugar de la cobertura de conocimientos. [Reportada examen 2026 (banco julio 2026)]

question: Universal Containers has deployed Agentforce to handle customer order tracking, returns, and loyalty support. The agent needs to balance conversational flexibility for customer inquiries with guaranteed execution of identity verification steps before accessing the account information. The development team is evaluating how to structure the agent's instruction pattern to meet both requirements. Which statement correctly describes hybrid reasoning in Agentforce Agent Script?
options: Hybrid reasoning uses multiple large language model (LLM) models simultaneously, with one model handling conversational responses and another model executing deterministic business logic through Flow integration.
Hybrid reasoning requires Canvas View for declarative instructions and Script View for procedural instructions, as each editor provides different capabilities for the respective instruction types.

Hybrid reasoning combines declarative natural language instructions that allow large language model (LLM) interpretation with procedural instructions using the '->' prefix that enforce guaranteed execution order.
explanation: El razonamiento híbrido en Agent Script permite que un solo agente mezcle dos estilos de instrucción en el mismo script: líneas de lenguaje natural ("|") que el LLM interpreta de manera flexible para partes conversacionales y líneas deterministas ("->") que se ejecutan como código en un orden garantizado, ideal para pasos obligatorios como la verificación de identidad antes del acceso a la cuenta. No requiere dos LLM separados, y Canvas View / Script View son solo editores sincronizados para el mismo agente, no una división entre tipos de instrucciones. [Reportada examen 2026 (banco julio 2026)]

question: An Agentforce Specialist is trying to troubleshoot a reported issue from an end user and they do not see the session in the Processed Sessions tab of Agentforce Observability. What should the specialist take into consideration?
options: The agent has not yet been registered in the Observability app so no sessions are processed.
The session is queued to be processed and can be viewed on the Unprocessed Sessions tab.
Sessions are batched on a 24-hour rolling process and the logs must be checked again the next day.
explanation: Agentforce Observability procesa los datos de la sesión de forma asincrónica: una vez que finaliza una sesión, primero se pone en cola antes de terminar de procesarse y pasar a Sesiones procesadas. Una entrada faltante en Sesiones Procesadas no significa por sí sola que el agente nunca estuvo registrado, y no hay un lote fijo de 24 horas que obligue a volver a verificar al día siguiente; la explicación mucho más probable es que la sesión simplemente no ha terminado de procesarse todavía. [Reportada examen 2026 (banco jul 2026)] [Nota de confianza: no pude confirmar el nombre literal "Unprocessed Sessions tab" en la documentación oficial (la página de Salesforce Help está renderizada en JS y no se pudo inspeccionar el texto); el mecanismo de "queued/procesamiento asíncrono" sí está confirmado, pero verifique el nombre exacto de la pestaña en la org antes de dar por sentado el detalle de UI.]

question: During retrieval augmented generation (RAG) quality testing, an Agentforce Specialist notices that tabular information from a custom Data 360 Document Ingestion Pipeline is losing its context because the data is scattered across multiple separate chunks. What is the most appropriate approach to resolve this?
options: Change the search index's parser from the default to Docling.
Use an ensemble retriever to stitch multiple chunks back together dynamically.
Switch the search index configuration to use only keyword search scoring.
explanation: El analizador predeterminado utilizado por una canalización de ingesta de documentos puede dividir tablas y otros diseños estructurados en varios fragmentos, perdiendo la relación entre filas, columnas y encabezados. Docling es una opción de analizador consciente de la estructura del documento disponible para el índice de búsqueda que comprende tablas y diseños complejos, manteniendo intactos los datos tabulares para que no se dispersen y pierdan contexto en los fragmentos. Un recuperador conjunto vuelve a clasificar los resultados de varios recuperadores, pero no corrige cómo se fragmentó un solo documento, y cambiar a una puntuación de solo palabras clave afecta la clasificación, no la estructura de los fragmentos. [Reportada examen 2026 (banco julio 2026)]

question: Sunrays Limited (SL) is deploying a new customer service agent using Agent Script. The Agentforce Specialist needs to update conversational state, navigate between different subagent (formerly known as a topic), and hand off conversations to a human agent when necessary. To minimize technical debt, the Agentforce Specialist wants to implement these capabilities without building any custom backend code. Which statement correctly describes how the Agentforce Specialist can implement these specific requirements?
options: The Agentforce Specialist can use @utils.setVariables, @utils.transition, and @utils.escalate directly.
The Agentforce Specialist can use most utilities directly, but @utils.escalate requires a custom Apex class to define the escalation queue.
The Agentforce Specialist can use most utilities out of the box, but @utils.transition requires a flow to define the target subagent at runtime.
explanation: Agent Script se entrega con un pequeño conjunto de utilidades deterministas nativas que no requieren código personalizado: setVariables (actualizar el estado de conversación), transición a (navegar a un subagente diferente), escalar (entregar a un agente humano) y end_session. Las tres capacidades descritas (actualizar el estado, navegar entre subagentes y escalar a un humano) se cubren de forma nativa a través de @utils.setVariables, @utils.transition y @utils.escalate, sin que se requiera ninguna clase o flujo de Apex para definir colas u objetivos. [Reportada examen 2026 (banco julio 2026)]

question: Sunrays Limited (SL) has a Flex prompt template that has been used for the last 3 months to answer questions based on user input. Now, SL wants to give a PDF as a second input. What is the best approach for the Agentforce Specialist to meet this requirement?
options: Reindex in order to add a new resource to an existing template.
Add a Resource anytime by navigating to the Resources section and configuring inputs.
Discard the current Flex template and create a new one with a resource.
explanation: Las prompt templates flexibles admiten agregar recursos (entradas adicionales, como un archivo/PDF) en cualquier momento abriendo la plantilla y configurando una nueva entrada en la sección Recursos; no es necesario volver a indexar nada ni descartar y reconstruir la plantilla existente. Esto conserva la configuración existente de la plantilla y 3 meses de ajuste mientras la amplía con la nueva entrada de PDF. [Reportada examen 2026 (banco julio 2026)]
